parameters.query: UPDATE tournaments t JOIN app_users u ON u.phone = $1 AND u.id = t.organizer_user_id SET t.entry_type = COALESCE($3, t.entry_type), t.invite_code = IF(COALESCE($3, t.entry_type) = 'IN_HOUSE', IF($4 = 1 OR t.invite_code IS NULL, $5, t.invite_code), NULL) WHERE t.code = $2 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'; SELECT t.entry_type, t.invite_code FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users u ON u.phone = $1 AND u.id = t.organizer_user_id WHERE t.code = $2
